summary: Full backend + frontend test of super_admin user management. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_users_admin.py (18 tests, all passing) covering authz (401 unauth, 403 branch_admin/staff on all endpoints), create (201 + one-time initial_password >=10 chars w/ letters+digits, no hashed_password / $2b$ leak in response or GET list), duplicate email 409, super_admin role rejected 422, is_superadmin cannot be set via API, super-admin target guard (PATCH/memberships/reset-password on super account -> 403), membership add/change-role/remove, non-existent branch -> 400, deactivate blocks login and reactivate restores, PATCH renames + toggles active, reset-password returns new one-time pw (old fails / new works), branch isolation regression on new user (only sees active assigned branch). Regression: full backend suite 52/52 passing. Frontend: Playwright confirmed staff has NO nav-users and /users redirects; super_admin sees nav-users, users-table, admin row lacks Manage button; create flow produces password-modal with password-value/copy-password-button/password-modal-close; manage flow: rename, add-membership (BDG-01 branch_admin), change role via role-select-BDG-01, remove-membership-BDG-01, toggle-active + confirm-toggle-active (label switches Deactivate<->Activate), reset-password -> password-modal with new value. Test users cleaned up via psql at the end.

integration_issues.flow: EditUserModal rapid successive actions (role change + immediate remove + toggle)
integration_issues.issue: Observed post-flow DB/UI state where JKT-01 was removed instead of / in addition to BDG-01 in one automated run, suggesting a possible race between overlapping async handle() responses updating `current` state out-of-order. Each individual action works correctly when awaited; only a concern for very fast successive clicks.

action_items: Consider serializing/awaiting the previous handle() promise in EditUserModal (or disabling controls while a request is in flight) to avoid out-of-order state overwrites when the user triggers successive membership actions rapidly. Non-blocking; individual endpoints work correctly per backend tests.

Minor: server-side create_user accepts unknown fields silently (extra=allow); explicit `model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` on UserCreate/UserUpdate would harden the API surface (currently is_superadmin is safely ignored because it isn't in the model, but defense-in-depth).
critical_code_review_comments: users.py `_get_manageable_user` correctly rejects super_admin targets with 403 BEFORE any mutation - good.
generate_password uses secrets + rejection sampling against password_policy_error - meets >=10 chars, letters+digits - verified in tests.
AdminUserOut does not expose hashed_password (verified no $2b$ or hashed_password substring in list/create response bodies).
MembershipRole enum limits roles to branch_admin/staff; super_admin input yields Pydantic 422 - verified.
EditUserModal races: multiple in-flight `handle` calls can overwrite `current` state out-of-order (see integration_issue). Suggest a queued mutation or disable-while-pending pattern.
CreateUserModal drops rows with empty branch_id and de-dupes client-side; server also enforces uniqueness via dict `seen` - good.

Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + POSTGRES_PASSWORD from env; export via `export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) && export $(grep -v '^#' /app/backend/.env | xargs)` before running pytest.
